highlights: Baseus 5-in-1 Type-C Hub Harmonica Adapter Grey – CAHUB-K0G

Enhance your connectivity with the Baseus 5-in-1 Type-C Hub Harmonica Adapter in sophisticated Grey (CAHUB-K0G). Transform a single USB Type-C port into a versatile hub featuring 2 USB 3.0 ports, SD and TF card slots, and a Type-C PD charging port.
Versatile Expansion: 5 ports in 1 hub – 2 x USB 3.0, SD card slot, TF card slot, and Type-C PD charging port.
Fast Data Transmission: 2 USB 3.0 ports support rapid 5Gbps data transmission for efficient multitasking.
Powerful Type-C PD Design: Supply 5V-20V strong power for laptops with the Type-C power supply design.
Aluminium Alloy Build: Sleek matte finish, anti-fingerprint, and durable aluminium alloy shell.
Safe and Reversible Design: Multiple safety protections ensure secure usage, and the reversible Type-C port allows hassle-free plug-and-play without drivers.
